items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Could you tell me about when you recorded with Jelly Roll Morton?

ctx.x: You don't remember the name of the song? You don't remember the year? Could you tell me about when you recorded with Jelly Roll Morton?
No, I can't. I got the record back there but I don't remember it.

items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee only confirms that Jelly Roll claimed to have written everything, without stating any personal interaction or relationship.

ctx.x: They changed it from downstairs, to upstairs on the ground floor. JCH and horn.

There was a question as to some of the things I've read and heard from other people that Jelly Roll wasn't always telling the truth. I heard statements - they said that he would have - he told everybody that he wrote everything, that he was responsible for every solo that everybody played and that he started jazz and the whole thing. Is that true?
